svg.title: Iranian cyber operations plotted under a ceiling
svg.desc: Iranian cyber operations plotted against a ceiling, the level of open war and a response the state could not absorb, which the operations stay under. The vertical position is provocation, the horizontal position is time from 2012 to 2025. Well below the ceiling and rising only gently: Shamoon in 2012, the Las Vegas Sands wiper in 2014, the election emails in 2020, and the water-utility slogan in 2023, the last the lowest of all. Close under the ceiling and far higher than the rest: the 2022 attack on Albania, a NATO member, and the 2025 Israel-Iran exchanges. A note marks the ceiling as not fixed but drifting upward. Each operation is sized to be felt and denied while staying under a response the state could not absorb.
svg.text: Iranian operations, calibrated to stay under the level of open war
the level of open war: a response the state could not absorb
the ceiling appears to be drifting up ↑
Each operation is sized to be felt and denied, and to stay under a response the state could not absorb.
The ceiling is not fixed: Albania and the 2025 exchanges sit higher than anything before them.
